newsitem.title: UK: BICC SAYS STG IMPACTS ON EUROPEAN PRICING.
newsitem.headline: BICC SAYS STG IMPACTS ON EUROPEAN PRICING.

text.p: BICC Plc, the UK cables to construction group, said on Wednesday that sterling's strength had "not been helpful" to its performance in the first six months of the year and may impact its European pricing levels.

BICC was not hit as hard as some other UK companies because it has some manufacturing bases in continental Europe, but chief executive Alan Jones said, "In our business we increasingly have to respond to pan European price levels, particularly in telecom and data areas, where our cost base is somewhat skewed towards the UK."
